components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one call to action per screen (RSVP NOW, CONFIRM RSVP); presses 4px into its shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 72px; padding: 0 44px; border: var(--stroke) solid var(--midnight); border-radius: 0; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--midnight); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.4; box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--yellow-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-pressed); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: var(--stroke) solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Disabled Button
components.description: The primary slot when the brawl is full or RSVPs are closed.
components.css: .ds-btn-disabled { min-height: 72px; padding: 0 44px; border: var(--stroke) solid var(--haze); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--haze); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 20px; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Exits and extras: BACK TO START, ADD TO CALENDAR. Flat, chalk outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: var(--stroke) solid var(--chalk); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--chalk); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--yellow); border-color: var(--yellow); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: var(--stroke) solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Answer Buttons
components.description: Single-choice square pills; yellow when selected, cyan for the car question.
components.css: .ds-answers { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--unit-3); padding: 4px; background: var(--panel); } .ds-answer { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 var(--unit-4); border: var(--stroke) solid var(--chalk); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--chalk); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-answer:hover { color: var(--yellow); border-color: var(--yellow); } .ds-answer[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--yellow); color: var(--midnight); border-color: var(--midnight); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard-sm); } .ds-answer--car[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--cyan); } .ds-answer:focus-visible { outline: var(--stroke) solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Numbered display label over a midnight field; cyan when the email is already on the list.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--unit-2); padding: var(--unit-4); background: var(--panel); color: var(--chalk); } .ds-field__label { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-input { height: 52px; padding: 0 var(--unit-3); background: var(--midnight); border: var(--stroke) solid var(--chalk); border-radius: 0; color: var(--chalk); font-family: var(--body); font-size: 26px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--haze); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: var(--stroke) solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-card { width: 326px; background: var(--panel); border: var(--stroke) solid var(--chalk); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard); color: var(--chalk); } .ds-card__bar { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: var(--deep); border-bottom: var(--stroke) solid var(--chalk); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-card__title { color: var(--cyan); } .ds-card__pos { color: var(--yellow); } .ds-card__grid { margin: 0; padding: var(--unit-4); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px var(--unit-4); } .ds-card__grid div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--unit-2); } .ds-card__grid dt { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 7px; color: var(--yellow); letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-card__grid dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--body); font-size: 24px; }

components.name: Confirmed Meter
components.description: HP-bar count of confirmed guests; cyan fill steps, never eases.
components.html: CONFIRMED10/20
components.css: .ds-meter { width: 220px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--unit-2); padding: var(--unit-3); background: var(--deep); } .ds-meter__head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; font-family: var(--display); } .ds-meter__label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--haze); letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-meter__count { font-size: 24px; color: var(--chalk); } .ds-meter__track { height: 24px; border: var(--stroke) solid var(--chalk); padding: 3px; background: var(--deep); } .ds-meter__fill { width: 50%; height: 100%; background: var(--cyan); transition: width 0.3s steps(3, end); }

components.css: .ds-hud { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--unit-6); padding: var(--unit-4); background: var(--deep); font-family: var(--display); } .ds-hud__side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--unit-2); } .ds-hud__side--cpu { align-items: flex-end; } .ds-hud__you { font-size: 12px; color: var(--cyan); letter-spacing: 0.12em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-hud__cpu { font-size: 12px; color: var(--yellow); letter-spacing: 0.12em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-hud__keys { display: flex; gap: var(--unit-2); } .ds-key { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: var(--stroke) solid var(--chalk); color: var(--chalk); } .ds-hud__mid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: var(--unit-2); } .ds-hud__label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--pink); letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-hud__count { font-size: 44px; color: var(--yellow); text-shadow: var(--shadow-hard-sm); } .ds-hud__hi { font-size: 10px; color: var(--haze); white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
Tennis first, rendered as a retro sprite world. The court, the racket, the ball and the rally are the visual vocabulary, drawn the way a late-80s cabinet would draw them: every form a stack of square pixels, every edge hard, every surface flat. The site is a game you're already inside: an attract screen with PRESS START, a HUD over a top-down court, a player card when you're in. The forms that serve the RSVP carry the same world, without decoration that would slow anyone down.

The palette is a night sky over the court: deep blue-black grounds with a starfield and a magenta perspective grid, lit by three loud accents (yellow for what matters most, pink for shadow and the court, cyan for you and success). Type comes in exactly two voices: a pixel display face that shouts in upper case, and a terminal face for anything people actually read. Depth exists only as a hard pink offset, like a sprite's drop shadow, and controls physically press into it.

The world rejects three things outright: modern UI softness (rounded corners, blur, gradients, glass, soft shadows); the glossy sports-brand look (photo heroes, italic speed type, swooshes); and the generic event-page or form-builder RSVP layout.
keyCharacteristics: Square pixels only: radius 0, 4px strokes, `shape-rendering: crispEdges` on all art.
One down-right hard shadow in pink; nothing blurs, nothing glows.
Two typefaces with strict jobs: Press Start 2P shouts, VT323 explains.
Dark grounds (deep, midnight, panel) carry about 60% of every screen; yellow, pink and cyan together stay near 10%.
Motion moves in `steps()`, never on an ease curve.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Yellow, pink and cyan together cover about 10% of a screen. Deep and midnight carry about 60%, chalk and panel the rest. The accents are loud because they are scarce.

rules.name: The Midnight-on-Pink Rule
rules.body: Text on a pink fill is always midnight. Chalk on pink fails contrast and is banned.

rules.name: The Scenery-Only Rule
rules.body: The starfield, grid and sunset steps (`sky-1` to `sky-3`, `grid`, `sunset-1` to `sunset-4` in `tokens.css`) and the sprite colors (`ball`, `ball-shade`, `racket-*`, `skin-*`, `hair`) are scenery. They stack in hard bands or live inside sprites. They never become UI fills, and they never blend into gradients. `sky-3` appears in UI only as the second, deeper shadow on PRESS START and YOU'RE IN!.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Press Start 2P never sets a sentence people need to read; VT323 never sets a call to action. If it's upper case and short, it's display. If it's a fact, an answer or an explanation, it's body.

rules.name: The Pixel Grid Rule
rules.body: Every dimension, gap and offset is a multiple of 4px. A 14px or 18px gap is a bug: round to the nearest `unit-*`.

rules.name: The One Call Rule
rules.body: Each screen has exactly one primary action. On the start screen it's RSVP NOW (or its disabled full or closed state); in the modal it's CONFIRM RSVP or UPDATE RSVP. Everything else is secondary or plain.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has a blur radius of 0. A blurred, spread or colored glow is a defect.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only primary actions, selected answers, the player card and the modal cast a shadow. Secondary buttons, inputs, meters and quiet cards sit flat.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Press Start 2P stays at 8px or larger, and VT323 at 18px or larger.

rules.name: The Pixel-Grid Type Rule
rules.body: Press Start 2P is drawn on an 8×8 grid, so its sizes sit on the 4px grid (8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32…). That keeps every font pixel on whole screen pixels on 2× displays; sizes like 9, 10, 11 or 14px smear. The pinned 26px BRADLY'S is the one exception.

dos: **Do** build every color, family, gap, stroke and shadow from the `tokens.css` names (`var(--yellow)`, `var(--unit-4)`, `var(--shadow-hard)`); never paste raw hex into component CSS.
**Do** keep every dimension on the 4px grid, and every corner at 0.
**Do** give the one primary action per screen the yellow fill and Hard shadow, and press it 4px into Pressed on tap.
**Do** set midnight text on yellow, cyan and pink fills.
**Do** draw new art and glyphs as pixel SVG with `crispEdges`, scaled by whole numbers, flipping sprites horizontally (never rotating them) to face each other.
**Do** use the 4px cyan outline at a 4px offset for focus on every interactive element.
**Do** keep Press Start 2P sizes on the 4px grid at 8px or larger, VT323 at 18px or larger, and touch targets at 44px or larger.
donts: **Don't** use rounded corners, blur, gradients, glassmorphism, glows or soft drop shadows anywhere: no modern UI softness.
**Don't** reach for the sports-brand look: no photo heroes, italic speed type or swooshes.
**Don't** let any screen fall back to a generic event page or form-builder RSVP layout; the RSVP lives inside the game world (HUD, modal frame, player card).
**Don't** put two primary buttons side by side, or give secondary buttons, inputs or quiet cards a shadow.
**Don't** ease motion with curves; use `steps()` only, and stop blinking under reduced motion.
**Don't** use emoji; use pixel glyphs (✕, ✓, ▲, ▼) or plain text.
**Don't** use the scenery colors (`sky-*`, `sunset-*`, `grid`, sprite colors) as UI fills, or blend them into gradients.
